lines.trans: Well, Dima, did you defeat our fearsome dragon?
Yes, of course, he agreed with me right away.
Respected sir, here is money for you, only I beg you.
Please find yourself some other restaurant.
With your permission I will refuse this money.
Because nobody needs someone else's tears, not even a homeless man.
Why did you refuse to take the money? There is an indecently large amount!
Then here is an indecently small amount, do not come for a couple of days.
Max, let us drink to our honesty today!
Or maybe it is better to drink to our love?
Until we drink to honesty, we will have no love.
I am checking the clock, in a minute I will die of sorrow!
